Cutaneous adipose tissue from psoriasis patients. Papillomaviruses replicate only in differentiating stratified squamous epithelium, so adipose has no permissive compartment -- yet 29.0% of these libraries carry a trace HPV read versus 28.2% of unselected skin, and none reaches the detection floor. Retained as a non-permissive-tissue negative control demonstrating that the trace background is not biology.

PRJNA872116 paired skin-metagenome specimens (SRA ScientificName = "skin metagenome"). Per-run title and tissue_source are empty, so keyword classification cannot reach them and they fall to muu. Selected for the paired presence-vs-activity test because their matched WGS libraries are HPV-positive in the Shen/Logan catalogue (presence_vs_activity/pairs_shen.tsv).

PRJNA signature study "The skin microbiome of DOCK8-deficient patients". Skin swab metatranscriptomes registered under the skin-metagenome taxid; per-run title and tissue_source carry no site keyword so classification falls to muu. DOCK8 deficiency is the primary immunodeficiency defined by cutaneous viral disease, so this is the immunocompromised arm of the compartment test (presence_vs_activity/PLAN.md 5.5b).
